title: Which Nights the Resort Charge of a Resort Lodging Stay Is Worked Out Over
content:
Which nights the resort charge of a Resort Lodging stay is worked out over depends on what the records of the stay show.

Where a departure is recorded on the reservation and the folio shows fewer nights consumed than the nights from the arrival date to that departure, the charge is worked out over the nights from the arrival date to the recorded departure, because the occupancy file is the incomplete record and the departure is the firm one.

Where no departure is recorded on the reservation, the charge is worked out over every night the reservation covers.

In every other case the charge is worked out over the nights the folio shows consumed.

| What the records of the stay show | The nights charged over |
| --- | --- |
| A departure recorded, and fewer nights consumed on the folio than from arrival to that departure | the nights from the arrival date to the recorded departure |
| No departure recorded on the reservation | every night the reservation covers |
| Any other case | the nights the folio shows consumed |

### Three hypothetical stays

A reservation covering the nights of the 8th to the 15th, with a departure recorded on the 13th and only 3 nights consumed on the folio, shows fewer nights consumed than the 5 nights from the arrival date to the recorded departure. The charge is worked out over those 5 nights.

A reservation covering the nights of the 8th to the 15th with no departure recorded is charged over every night the reservation covers, which is 7 nights.

A reservation covering the same nights, with a departure recorded on the 13th and 5 nights consumed on the folio, shows no shortfall against the 5 nights from arrival to departure, so it falls into neither of the first two and the charge is worked out over the 5 nights the folio shows consumed.
